files.README.md:
# Byte downloads
`serve(data, range_header=None)` returns `(status, headers, body)` where data
is bytes and headers include `Content-Length`. No range returns 200 and full
data. One `bytes=start-end` range has an inclusive end; an omitted end means
EOF. `bytes=-N` means the last N bytes. Clamp an end past EOF. A range with
start beyond EOF, zero suffix, reverse bounds, or bad syntax returns 416,
empty body, and `Content-Range: bytes */<length>`. A successful range
returns 206 and `Content-Range: bytes <start>-<end>/<length>`.
The header must exactly match one of `bytes=D-D`, `bytes=D-`, or `bytes=-D`,
where each D is one or more ASCII digits 0 through 9. Leading zeros are allowed.
No whitespace (including trailing newlines), signs on numbers, underscores,
Unicode digits, extra separators, or multiple ranges are allowed. Both endpoints
cannot be omitted. Every range on empty data returns 416.

"""Regression tests for the single-range download behavior in README.md."""

import unittest

from download.service import serve

DATA = b'0123456789'  # 10 bytes


class ServeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assert_range(self, header, status, body, content_range=None):
        st, headers, got = serve(DATA, header)
        self.assertEqual(status, st, f'status for {header!r}')
        self.assertEqual(body, got, f'body for {header!r}')
        self.assertEqual(str(len(body)), headers['Content-Length'],
                         f'Content-Length for {header!r}')
        if content_range is not None:
            self.assertEqual(content_range, headers['Content-Range'],
                             f'Content-Range for {header!r}')
        else:
            self.assertNotIn('Content-Range', headers, header)

    def test_no_range_returns_200_full_data(self):
        self.assert_range(None, 200, DATA)

    def test_inclusive_end_keeps_last_byte(self):
        # Regression: the old exclusive slice dropped the end byte.
        self.assert_range('bytes=0-4', 206, b'01234', 'bytes 0-4/10')
        self.assert_range('bytes=9-9', 206, b'9', 'bytes 9-9/10')

    def test_open_end_selects_through_eof(self):
        self.assert_range('bytes=7-', 206, b'789', 'bytes 7-9/10')

    def test_suffix_selects_last_n(self):
        self.assert_range('bytes=-3', 206, b'789', 'bytes 7-9/10')

    def test_suffix_larger_than_data_selects_all(self):
        self.assert_range('bytes=-99', 206, DATA, 'bytes 0-9/10')

    def test_end_past_eof_is_clamped(self):
        self.assert_range('bytes=8-99', 206, b'89', 'bytes 8-9/10')

    def test_leading_zeros_allowed(self):
        self.assert_range('bytes=007-009', 206, b'789', 'bytes 7-9/10')

    def test_416_shape(self):
        st, headers, body = serve(DATA, 'bytes=11-13')
        self.assertEqual(416, st)
        self.assertEqual(b'', body)
        self.assertEqual('0', headers['Content-Length'])
        self.assertEqual('bytes */10', headers['Content-Range'])

    def test_unsatisfiable_and_malformed_headers_are_416(self):
        for header in [
            'bytes=10-20',        # start at EOF
            'bytes=30-40',        # start past EOF
            'bytes=3-1',          # reverse bounds
            'bytes=-0',           # zero suffix
            'bytes=1-3-5',        # extra separator
            'bytes=1-5,1-2',      # multiple ranges
            'bytes=',             # both endpoints omitted
            'bytes=-',            # both endpoints omitted
            'bytes =0-5',         # whitespace after unit
            'bytes= 0-5',         # whitespace after '='
            'bytes=0-5 ',         # trailing whitespace
            'bytes=0-5\n',        # trailing newline
            'bytes=+1-5',         # sign on number
            'bytes=1_0-5',        # underscore (Python-style spelling)
            'bytes=\u0661-\u0662',  # Unicode digits
            'BYTES=0-5',          # wrong-case unit
            'range=0-5',          # wrong unit
        ]:
            st, headers, body = serve(DATA, header)
            self.assertEqual(416, st, f'status for {header!r}')
            self.assertEqual(b'', body, f'body for {header!r}')
            self.assertEqual('0', headers['Content-Length'], header)
            self.assertEqual('bytes */10', headers['Content-Range'], header)

    def test_any_range_on_empty_data_is_416(self):
        for header in ('bytes=0-0', 'bytes=0-', 'bytes=-1'):
            st, headers, body = serve(b'', header)
            self.assertEqual(416, st, f'empty data with {header!r}')
            self.assertEqual(b'', body, header)
            self.assertEqual('0', headers['Content-Length'], header)
            self.assertEqual('bytes */0', headers['Content-Range'], header)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
